title: Add points_ledger and reward_redemptions to write_payloads.json and the PHASE D zero-denial oracle in firestore_rules.test.mjs

evidence.quote: "_comment": "Canonical per-collection write-payload fixtures derived from Dart codec encode() outputs...",
test('update and delete are denied even for owner (append-only)', async () => {

why: write_payloads.json's own header calls PAYLOADS 'the single source of truth for valid doc shapes, consumed by Phase D and E,' and PHASE D's comment claims 'a legitimate owner must be able to write every whitelisted collection without a single permission-denied error... the zero-denial oracle catches it before it reaches production.' In reality the fixture enumerates 12 collections and PHASE D enumerates 15 (ending at curriculum_scopes, line 767-768) — points_ledger and reward_redemptions are absent from both, and (verified in tool/emit_fixture_payloads.dart, not in this batch) the generator's payloads map has no entry for either, confirming the omission is systematic. Neither collection has a hasOnly whitelist today so nothing is silently broken right now, but this exact rules file has independently hit the 'hasOnly whitelist drops a real field → permission-denied in production' bug three times for other collections (profile_programs.updated_at, curriculum_tracks.purged/purged_at, bookmarks.track_type — all documented in this file's own comments). Since points_ledger/reward_redemptions are the most obvious remaining candidates for a future hasOnly addition (every sibling snapshot/ledger collection already has one), the safety net built specifically to catch that failure mode has a blind spot exactly where the next occurrence is most likely.
recommendation: Add points_ledger and reward_redemptions payloads to tool/emit_fixture_payloads.dart's map, regenerate write_payloads.json via `make emit-fixtures`, and add both to PHASE D's oracle list and PHASE E's round-trip table.
acceptance_criteria: write_payloads.json gains `points_ledger` and `reward_redemptions` keys after `make emit-fixtures`
PHASE D's owner-write-succeeds test includes both new PAYLOADS entries

corrections: Minor: 'documented in this file's own comments' blends firestore.rules (profile_programs.updated_at, curriculum_tracks.purged — confirmed there) with firestore_rules.test.mjs (bookmarks.track_type, confirmed there); substance of all 3 precedents independently verified regardless.
